// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// Amendment C2's parent record: who they are, when they registered, whether
// they have added an email. Exact match, named columns, no family code, no
// children and no count of them.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function parentByExactEmail(email) {
  return db.parent.findUnique({
    where: { email },
    select: { id: true, createdAt: true },
  });
}
